boundaries: This is research evidence only. The Inventory record and human guide are discovery and explanation surfaces, not authority.
Do not equate a Mint projection, schema-valid document, hash, or receipt with policy evaluation, theorem proof, obligation discharge, or canonical promotion.
Do not generalize any Lean theorem beyond its exact formal model, source revision, toolchain, dependencies, and successful build receipt.
Keep DomainSpec semantic ownership separate from CAV2 authority and promotion ownership.
Keep private DomainSpec, Saturn, and CAV2 material out of the public arcanum subtree.
key_points: The research conditionally selects a shared record contract with owner-specific catalogs and generated views (TOP-03); independent catalogs with a derived crosswalk (TOP-02) remain the fallback, while one cross-project canonical registry (TOP-01) is rejected.
The human guide now explains the substrate for non-specialists, including Mint, Lean, Cedar, first-order logic, and Datalog.
Mint's Cedar and first-order-logic projections currently establish structural parity only; they do not establish Cedar evaluation, Datalog evaluation, authorization, or proof discharge.

The Lean AgentPermissionKernel and GovernsAcyclicity targets rebuild in their current environments. FunctorialResidueStructure is currently blocked by a toolchain and dependency mismatch, so its source theorem must not be reported as a current reproducible build.

The approved research establishes no canonical adoption, complete executed DomainSpec proof witness, discharge, deterministic CAV2 enforcement, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production readiness.
